title: The Adjacent Affordance
idiom: flat matte surrealist gouache, the door beside the wall
hero_prompt: Flat matte gouache painting in the spirit of Magritte's surrealism, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a long high plain stone wall cutting straight across a country road under a clear blue sky; the road does not end at the wall but bends a few steps to the right, where a small arched wooden door stands open in the wall with warm sunlight pouring through it, and a traveller, a man with a satchel, turns toward the door instead of the wall.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a sky-blue ground, no shading or gradients: a solid block of wall with a small arched doorway standing open at its right-hand edge. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
